mechanism: After a causal 15-minute external pool raid is classified from the first complete five seconds of observed signed flow and price progress, do not chase the completed state. Rest a source-level limit after decision plus 500 ms and require one-tick penetration for conservative full fill.

state.pool: nearest still-live radius-2 confirmed 15-minute swing pool, usable only after the second completed right-side bar
state.raid: first observed 500 ms trade bucket strictly through the pool
state.window: the complete five seconds beginning at the raid bucket
state.accept: signed progress > 0, outside dwell > 0.5, signed aggressive turnover > 0
state.reject: signed progress <= 0 after a positive outward excursion

action.entry: resting source-price limit; full fill only after one-tick penetration
action.target: original pre-existing external pool in the selected direction, frozen before outcome
action.stop: original completed-state structural extreme plus one tick

account.normal_desired_natural_r: >=1.0 without changing entry, stop or target

decision: A single positive week is insufficient. The exact action must preserve meaningful density and show positive cost-net account value in more than one frozen short window without one-trade dependence. Otherwise close without adjacent threshold, execution, target, stop, ML, risk or leverage rescue.
